statutes.title: Covenants of Habitability and Repair
statutes.summary: Landlord covenants that the premises are fit for the use intended by the parties and will keep the premises in reasonable repair during the term of the lease.

statutes.title: Anti-Lockout and Lockout Damages
statutes.summary: Prohibits landlords from forcefully excluding tenants, changing locks, or shutting off utilities (heat, water, electric) to force a tenant out.

statutes.title: Landlord and Tenant Relationships (Security Deposits)
statutes.summary: Regulates security deposit limits (max 1.5 months rent), notice of damages, and timeline for deposit return (30 days).
remedies: itemized list of damages within 30 days

escalation_steps.detail: Send a dated, written notice citing MCL 554.139 via certified mail or trackable delivery to create a paper trail.
Contact municipal housing inspectors (e.g., City of Troy Building & Code Enforcement) to conduct an official inspection and issue violations.
File a consumer protection complaint with the Michigan Attorney General's office if widespread or persistent habitability failures occur.
Consult Michigan Legal Help or an attorney regarding depositing rent into an escrow account or bringing action in district court.
